text:
sam: Kicking off a POC scoping thread for GreenBank — want to lock success criteria, perf targets, and an eval plan. TL;DR: customer cares about latency, cost per txn, and precision on underwriting prompts.
maria: OK. Can you share their expected QPS/concurrency and typical request shape?
sam: They expect ~50 qps peak, mostly short prompts (avg 120 tokens in, 80 out). Burst to 100 qps for 10-15m during batch runs.
dan: For 50 qps baseline we need p95 latency targets — what does GreenBank want?
maria: They asked for p95 < 350ms for online scoring and p99 < 700ms as stretch. They’ll accept higher for batch.
sam: Also cost sensitivity: finance said under $0.20 per scored session (including embedding + generation).
akash: Important: they require KMS integration and data residency in eu-west-1. Security questionnaire coming Wednesday.
maria: Ok on residency, we can set up Private deployment in eu-west-1 mirror. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS connector.
sam: Now the eval matrix. Proposal: small labeled eval set of 500 examples for core underwriting prompts; metrics: top-level accuracy/ROC AUC, hallucination rate (false claims), and quality score from SME (1-5). Acceptance criteria: AUC >= 0.92, hallucination rate < 2%, SME mean >= 4.2. Thoughts?
dan: Those are reasonable. Add latency cost constraints: p95 <= 350ms at 50 qps, cost <= $0.20 per session measured on our benchmark harness. Also define sampling procedure for eval (stratified by customer segments).
akash: Who runs the evals? We'll need SE + their ML lead to own prompt labeling. We can offer to run baseline runs and provide eval harness.
maria: Agree. Timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) — security q + infra setup; Week 1 — data ingest & baseline runs; Week 2 — prompt tuning & perf tuning; Week 3 — final acceptance eval + handover. GreenBank expects decision in 4 weeks.
sam: Need sample prompts and 500 labeled cases from customer by Friday to hit week1. @dan can you coordinate an eval harness?
dan: Yep, I'll spin up an eval repo and the harness. Will post the instructions and a small runbook. Quick config to run locally:
```
# run local eval
model: redwood-llama-13b-quant
batch_size: 16
(seq_len_cutoff): 256
metrics: [auc, hallucination_rate, sme_score]
```

akash: Also flag: if we use quantized 13B model we expect lower costs but might see a 5-10% quality delta vs fp16. Add a fallback plan to a fp16 variant if SME scores drop.
maria: Good call. Add rollback policy: if SME mean < 4.0 after tuning, fallback to fp16 model variant; cost overrun threshold: if running model pushes per-session cost > $0.30, trigger exec review.
sam: Security Qs — they require SOC2 evidence and encryption in transit+at rest, and an audit log for queries. I can attach our SOC2 summary and platform logs export path.
akash: For audit logs we'll enable per-tenant audit export, retention 90 days. For KMS key rotation, communicate that keys are customer controlled.
dan: One more: define how we measure hallucination rate. Proposal: sample 500 responses, SMEs flag hallucinations. Hallucination rate = flagged / total. Acceptance < 2%.
maria: Fine. Also define random seed and sampling window for reproducibility.
sam: Ok next: pricing & burn estimates. Quick calc: at average 200 tokens total per session, redwood-hosted pricing approximates $0.0005 per token for this model -> $0.10 per session compute; embeddings per session add $0.03; infra + ops buffer = $0.02 -> total $0.15. If quantized model reduces token cost 30% -> $0.105. We should share this to finance.
akash: I'll produce a short cost worksheet with best/worst cases and show where batching helps.
dan: Operational blockers: network peering for private deployment, and SLA for Dedicated capacity during go-live. I'll raise tickets.
maria: Can we get the customer to commit to the labeled eval set and an ML contact this week? That's the gating item.
sam: I'll ping them. If they provide labeled set by Friday we can stick to timeline.
deploy-bot: Deployment request created: env=eu-west-1-private, owner=dan, req=1799990001. ETA 3 business days. :rocket:
maria: Great. I'll draft the acceptance checklist and circulate. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
